about: The label set of the Jev comparison (#4298). Each case is a closed issue of this project, with the title and the start of the body as filed, and the type, priority, Value and Effort that a person set on it. `devops roadmap eval jev` asks the analysis model and Jev for the proposal of each case and counts how often each field agrees with the person's. The bodies are the first 400 characters of the issue with the white space folded.
